projectDescription: A virtual kiosk web application that lets small businesses manage their product catalog, receive customer orders, track deliveries, and analyze sales in real time.
keyFeatures: Product catalog with categories, images, stock and pricing
Shopping cart with quantity management and subtotals
Order management with real-time status updates (pending, confirmed, preparing, on the way, delivered)
Multiple payment methods: Yape, Plin, bank transfer, and cash on delivery
Delivery scheduling with time windows and map-based address selection
Admin dashboard with sales stats, revenue charts, peak-hour analysis, and top customers
Electronic invoice (factura electrónica) generation with IGV calculation
Store customization: brand colors, logo upload, business name/RUC/address
Customer order tracking portal with push notifications
Dark mode support and PWA (Progressive Web App) capabilities
publicApiSurface: initDB() — initializes localStorage with default products, settings, and admin phone
addOrder(order) — create a new order and trigger notifications
updateOrderStatus(orderId, newStatus, note) — change order status and notify customer
getSettings() / saveSettings(settings) — business configuration (name, phone, RUC, delivery cost)
getTheme() / saveTheme(theme) — store color theme settings
generateInvoice(order) — create and download an electronic invoice HTML
getMostProfitableProducts(limit) — analytics: top products by margin
getTopCustomers(limit) — analytics: top customers by spend
getPeakHours() — hourly order and revenue statistics
getProductImages() / saveProductImage(productId, imageData) — product image management
isAdmin(phone) — check if a phone number matches the admin credential
notifyCustomerStatusChange(phone, orderNumber, status) — send in-app + push notification to customer
scheduleDelivery(orderId, deliveryWindow, deliveryDate) — schedule a future delivery
addActivityLog(action, description, type) — append to admin activity log
